stem.text: Which statement describes what happens when 2-chloro-2-methylpropane is warmed with $\text{NaOH(aq)}$?

A.text: This secondary halogenoalkane reacts by a mixture of an $\text{S}_\text{N}1$ and an $\text{S}_\text{N}2$ mechanism.

B.text: This secondary halogenoalkane reacts only by an $\text{S}_\text{N}2$ mechanism.

C.text: This tertiary halogenoalkane reacts mostly by an $\text{S}_\text{N}1$ mechanism.

D.text: This tertiary halogenoalkane **does not** react with hydroxide ions under these conditions.
